# chesswithprince.com

An in-browser chess workspace for playing, studying openings, and replaying master games.

- [Play](https://play.chesswithprince.com/play): Play chess against Stockfish.
- [Openings](https://play.chesswithprince.com/openings): Drill opening lines.
- [Games](https://play.chesswithprince.com/games): Replay master games.
- [Study](https://play.chesswithprince.com/study): Review and analyze games.
